fields.reason: StratagemInfo +80: an integer use count, or 'unlimited' (the native 0xFFFFFFFF value). Eagles use the same field for uses per rearm and are excluded.

StratagemInfo +0x54: the call-in countdown before the delivery starts, read once when a beacon of this stratagem is created (0x879900). The game's upgrades and mission effects apply on top; the pod fall, the orbital travel and the aircraft's flight are not part of it.

StratagemInfo +0x40/+0x48: the code entered to call the stratagem in, a list of 1 to 9 directions ('up', 'right', 'down', 'left'). A changed code is a Runtime-owned array; the HUD stratagem list is redrawn to match.
The stratagem's upper-case name (loadout screen and in-mission stratagem menu). Set by naming a catalogued stratagem whose name it takes.
The stratagem's cased name (loadout details). Set by naming a catalogued stratagem whose name it takes.
The stratagem's description (loadout details). Set by naming a catalogued stratagem whose description it takes.
The stratagem's icon (loadout slots and grid, in-mission stratagem HUD). Set by naming a catalogued stratagem whose icon it takes.
EagleComponentData +0x14 of the stratagem's own jet: one of the eight native landing patterns (0..7, allowedValues lists the bombs of each). Bomb Eagles only.
EagleComponentData +0x2C of the stratagem's own jet: seconds between consecutive bomb releases. Bomb Eagles only.
EagleComponentData +0x28 of the stratagem's own jet: how long the strafe fires, or the rocket salvo window split between the targets. Strafing Run and 110mm Rocket Pods only.
EagleComponentData +0x6C of the stratagem's own jet: how far the strafe's aim walks along the heading during the attack. Strafing Run only.
EagleComponentData +0x24 of the stratagem's own jet: the radius around the beacon in which the call picks its (best 8) targets. Strafing Run and 110mm Rocket Pods only.
EagleComponentData +0x1C of the stratagem's own jet: the approach heading relative to the thrower-to-beacon direction (90 across the throw, 180 along it).
EagleComponentData +0x10 of the stratagem's own jet: the attack kind (strafe, rocket, airstrike). Read-only: the kind selects the jet's mounted weapons and branches.
Derived: the bomb count of the native landing pattern eagle.airstrike_pattern selects (plus a per-jet extra-bomb stat, 0 by default). Change it through eagle.airstrike_pattern.
Derived: eagle.fire_duration x the jet gun's 4000 rounds per minute / 60. Change it through eagle.fire_duration.
BombardmentComponentData +0x18 of the orbital's own bombardment record: the salvo count, read once when the barrage is created (0x854890).

BombardmentComponentData +0x04 of the orbital's own bombardment record: the shells of each salvo, read once when the barrage is created (0x854889). The shells cycle through the record's listed shell types.
BombardmentComponentData +0x08: the fixed part of the delay to the next shell of a salvo, re-read for every shell (0x85354B).
BombardmentComponentData +0x0C: the random part of the delay to the next shell (delay = fixed + random x this), re-read for every shell (0x853545).
BombardmentComponentData +0x1C: the fixed part of the delay to the next salvo, re-read at every salvo (0x853940).
BombardmentComponentData +0x20: the random part of the delay to the next salvo (delay = fixed + random x this), re-read at every salvo (0x85393A).
BombardmentComponentData +0x24: the per-shell scatter around the salvo's centre, in the record's own units (the 120mm's is 27), re-read for every shell (0x8526AF).
BombardmentComponentData +0x28: the scatter of each salvo's centre around the target, in the record's own units, re-read at every salvo (0x8538E7).

TurretComponentData +16: each frame the pitch step is multiplied by min(1, e^-value), e = the yaw error (degrees) left after this frame's yaw step. 0 = pitch and yaw move independently; 1 on direct-fire sentries; 4 on the mortars (the barrel barely elevates until it faces the target). Read every frame: also changes deployed sentries.

SensorEyeComponentData +4: the sensing range across the sensor's forward axis (the sensor node sits on the turret head). The range at angle a is |cos a| x (targeting.range ahead or targeting.rear_range behind) + (1 - |cos a|) x this. -1 (every native sentry) = targeting.range, i.e. 360-degree sensing. Copied at spawn: applies to sentries deployed after the write.

SensorEyeComponentData +8: the sensing range behind the sensor node (see targeting.side_range). -1 (every native sentry) = targeting.range. Copied at spawn: applies to sentries deployed after the write.
